WHAT TO NOTICE


Catalog & sources
The W3C index includes drafts and historical specifications. MDN adds browser-specific and legacy properties. Custom properties are represented by --*, not counted as infinitely many separate names.
“Syntax accepted” means this browser accepts a declaration. It does not guarantee a visible effect, interoperability, or full implementation. A value can require a particular layout, an at-rule, printing, or another feature.
Data is a fixed snapshot. Follow the source links for changes and definitions not included in the snapshot.
